description: Use this when someone asks what a mahadasha or antardasha means in Vedic astrology in general, or how long one lasts, without asking for their own dates: "what does Rahu mahadasha mean", "Saturn mahadasha effects", "Jupiter mahadasha Venus antardasha", "how long is Ketu dasha". Returns the length of the period, what the planet stands for, what its years tend to bring in daily life, when they tend to work and when they strain, every antardasha in order with its length, and for an antardasha asked about, its note. For the person’s own dates use current_dasha. Read a period by where the planet sits in the chart, never as good or bad in itself; no fear.

antardasha.description: Optional: the antardasha lord inside it.
